name: Amelia Earhart Award (miniature medal body)
size_basis: Raster proportion: the ribbon in images/medals/amelia_earhart.webp is 0.625 in wide (ribbon measured 62 px in the source raster) (miniature 5/8 in; coordination chat citing DoDM 1348.33; CAPR 39-3 gives no medal dimensions); the medal body is measured at 62 x 66 source px = 0.625 x 0.665 in at that scale. Width kept from the previous asset; the product photo shows the medal disc and suspension ring, height now 0.7986 in (was 0.6653).

ribbon_ref.note: medal body only; the ribbon asset supplies the stripes and devices. ribbon_attach is where the ribbon meets the suspension loop.

source: https://vanguardmil.com/products/civil-air-patrol-amelia-earhart-miniature-medal; vendor product photograph (Vanguard Military Products), used only as a measurement reference; licence not stated by the vendor

fit.metric: silhouette IoU vs photo foreground mask at working resolution
fit.note: Posterised to 5 flat sampled tones (smoothed, Chaikin + RDP, specks dropped); 4 nested tone layers over the traced silhouette.
